draftFindings.observation: Queued draft was a 7-line stub; a complete module was implemented.
Parent browser: tiny runner, RELAY label under the runner, faint chalk. Fixed with a 2x camera, moved label and bold chalk/footprints.

Parent browser and reviewer jitter probes: climbs needed near frame-exact input. Fixed with kick grace (0.1 s after leaving, 0.12 s pre-buffer), slower momentum decay, one-kick canyons and perturbed-route tests.
Runner and goal left the screen or sat under the HUD (reviewer; parent saw it in the course-3 canyon). Camera now clamped per sub-step; visibility asserted over legal and random runs.
"Kick any wall" corrected to non-slick; kick prompt only shown when a kick is available.
Sprite floated 2 px above the collider; aligned.
stepRun discarded the rest of a frame after a reset, diverging across rates; now consistent at 30/60/120 Hz.

finalReview.evidence: 33/33 tests, 99.46% line and 96.48% branch coverage. Invalid time inert; reviewer beam-search route wins identically at 30/60/120 Hz (1600, 4 lives); 80 random scripts identical across rates; runner never above 60 px or below 275 px on the legal route; no penetration/NaN in 60 random and 200 accounting runs; energy ledger exact; altitude search bounded ~100-125 px above the highest roof; loss fires once and freezes.
finalReview.limitations: Reviewer edge-hugging route tolerates single 33 ms shifts at 85-99% per course; the authored human routes are the jitter pass criterion.

draftFindings.observation: Queue held only a 3-line test stub; a complete module was implemented.
Parent browser: 8 px player, untranslated EXIT, faint linkage, empty upper half. Fixed with 14x20 player (collider = sprite), localized exit, overhead brass rods with letter badges.
A key could hover over a pit and the player could stand on a 1 px overlap. Player now tips off edges; key drops clamp to support.
Landing on a rising lift could report a spurious jam; 0.01-2 px gap sweep now shows none.
Unlock score could be re-banked after rewinds; now banked only on machine clear.
Hint plate covered part of Machine 3; removed, hint moved to the bottom bar.
Loose-tolerance rate test replaced by full-state equality at 30/60/120 Hz.

finalReview.evidence: 33/33 tests, 98.84% line coverage. Invalid time inert; 40 random timelines identical at 30/60/120 Hz; zero rider drift including mid-travel reversal; 4,550-run gear/position sweep and 29,048-run key sweep found no penetration (mechanisms jam instead of pushing); 240 goal-directed random runs finite; coyote/buffer once per real exit; terminal callback once and frozen; reviewer bot wins all machines at 30/60/120 Hz; 14 px bilingual canvas text; touch controls cover every action.
finalReview.limitations: Standing under a descending press jams the whole press-and-lift group by design (recoverable). No soft-lock without legal recovery found.

draftFindings.observation: Queue held only a 3-line test stub; a complete module was implemented.
Parent browser: host status showed only the genre; objective banner overlapped HUD; phone HUD small. Fixed with a bilingual status line and a three-line HUD.

Following the flare cue stalled the wing; flare and stall cues later alternated; "too fast" cue drove into stall. Fixed with a flare window over the pad with wings level, cue hysteresis, a guarded too-fast cue and speed-hold pitch stability.
Crash text blamed speed when sink rate failed; now names the failing criterion.
Courses 2-3 were only autopilot-finishable. Added LIFT markers, target-altitude line, gate/pad guidance, wider windows and a prompt-text-only test requiring 27/30 clean runs per ridge and rate.
Relaunch from Warm-up Spur gate 3 left ~5 m margin; gates retuned and margins tested.
Invisible walls in open sky replaced by visible terrain and an edge prompt with a key.
Missed-gate prompt pointed at a gate behind the glider and named no key; now "Hold Left: turn back" and gates can be re-flown in either direction.
Crash/clear screens now disclose their automatic countdown.
Text-only landings failed on touchdown speed; handled by speed-hold stability and a guarded too-fast cue.

finalReview.evidence: 46/46 tests, 99.35% line coverage. Invalid time inert; identical state at 30/60/120/240 Hz over 40 seeds; still-air mechanical energy never increased across 10 adversarial policies x 3 courses x 3 rates; visible edge walls; safe landings from tested relaunch checkpoints; gate order enforced and not farmable; reviewer status.en-only policy finished every ridge 30/30 at all rates and 27-30/30 with zero attempts lost at 0.4 s lag, with no corrective-prompt cycling within 1.5 s.
finalReview.limitations: Ridge 3 is the tightest under heavy lag. Gates count in either direction (a deliberate rule change for re-flying). Course 1 is forgiving.
